### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.completion

### Neovim version

0.11 (!at least latest Nightly build!)

### Description


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/25199bd4-fb94-4a7d-b83e-83f3be300da4

When the `lsp` returns functions as snippets, the signature help is not updated when navigating the snippet to edit the arguments.
See the video, using `completion = { callSnippet = "Replace", keywordSnippet = "Replace" }` for both `mini.completion` and `nvim-cmp`.

### Reproduction

1. Create separate 'nvim-repro' config directory:
    - '~/.config/nvim-repro/' on Unix
    - '~/AppData/Local/nvim-repro/' on Windows

2. Inside 'nvim-repro' directory create a file named 'init.lua'.
   Populate it with the following content:

<details>
<summary>init.lua</summary>

```lua
---@diagnostic disable: undefined-global

local function signature_should_follow(first, second)
  vim.print(first)
  vim.print(second)
end

local function clone(path_to_site)
  local mini_path = path_to_site .. "pack/deps/start/mini.nvim"
  if not vim.uv.fs_stat(mini_path) then
    vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
    local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "--filter=blob:none", "https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim", mini_path }
    vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
    vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim | helptags ALL")
    vim.cmd('echo "Installed `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
  end
end

local function setup_cmp(cmp_sources)
  local cmp = require("cmp")
  cmp.setup({
    snippet = {
      expand = function(args) -- mini.snippets expands snippets from lsp...
        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-global
        MiniSnippets.default_insert({ body = args.body }) -- Insert at cursor
      end,
    },
    sources = cmp.config.sources(cmp_sources),
    mapping = cmp.mapping.preset.insert(),
    completion = { completeopt = "menuone,noinsert" },
  })
end

local function setup_mini()
  require("mini.completion").setup({
    auto_setup = false,
    source_func = "omnifunc",
  })
  if vim.fn.has("nvim-0.11") == 1 then vim.opt.completeopt:append("fuzzy") end
  MiniDeps.later(function() MiniIcons.tweak_lsp_kind() end)
end

local path_to_site = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/"
clone(path_to_site)
require("mini.deps").setup({ path = { package = path_to_site } })

vim.g.mapleader = " "
local use_cmp = false
MiniDeps.now(function()
  require("mini.basics").setup()
  vim.cmd.colorscheme("randomhue")

  require("mini.icons").setup()
  require("mini.notify").setup()
  require("mini.snippets").setup() -- only using lsp snippets
  if use_cmp then
    MiniDeps.add({ source = "hrsh7th/nvim-cmp", depends = { "hrsh7th/cmp-nvim-lsp", "ray-x/lsp_signature.nvim" } })
    require("lsp_signature").setup()
    setup_cmp({ { name = "nvim_lsp" } })
  else
    setup_mini()
  end

  MiniDeps.add("williamboman/mason.nvim")
  MiniDeps.add("williamboman/mason-lspconfig.nvim")
  MiniDeps.add("neovim/nvim-lspconfig")
  require("mason").setup()
  require("mason-lspconfig").setup({ ensure_installed = { "lua_ls" } })
  require("lspconfig").lua_ls.setup({
    on_attach = function(_, buf_id) -- client
      if use_cmp then
        require("lsp_signature").on_attach()
      else
        vim.bo[buf_id].omnifunc = "v:lua.MiniCompletion.completefunc_lsp"
      end
    end,
    settings = {
      Lua = {
        completion = { callSnippet = "Replace", keywordSnippet = "Replace" },
        diagnostics = { globals = { "vim", "MiniDeps" } },
        runtime = { version = "LuaJIT" },
        telemetry = { enable = false },
        workspace = {
          ignoreSubmodules = true,
          checkThirdParty = false,
          library = {
            vim.env.VIMRUNTIME,
            "${3rd}/luv/library",
            "$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  })
  require("mini.statusline").setup({})
end)

```

</details>

3. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim` (i.e. execute `nvim` with `NVIM_APPNAME` environment variable set to "nvim-repro").
   Wait for all dependencies to install.

Note: after reporting the issue, it is safe (and even recommended for cleaner possible future bug reports) to remove 'nvim-repro' config from the system:
- Delete config directory ('~/.config/nvim-repro' on Unix).
- Delete data directory ('~/.local/share/nvim-repro' on Unix).
- Delete state directory ('~/.local/state/nvim-repro' on Unix).

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

Yes, improving signature help behavior regarding tracking is on the todo list. Currently it is updated based only on the character to the left of the cursor (whether it is special trigger character for signature help or not) to reduce number of requests to LSP server.

It is mostly designed for a "start signature help and type one character at a time until ')' or Insert mode exit" use case. Making it work for snippet navigation and possible cursor movement in Insert mode is a worthwhile goal. It just requires doing a research about by how much it will increase performance and possibly making a decision about suitable compromise. I'll take a look.

This should now be resolved on latest `main`. Signature window should update without delay on every cursor movement in Insert mode if it is already shown. It should be more snippet-session-friendly now. Thanks again for pointing this out (I meant to get to it, but forgot).
